text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I hand a newly-delivered fan letter to<n>Grass
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I recognize the name on this one.<n>So they were
nice enough to write me<n>again!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
They're always so proper with their<n>salutations
and sign-offs. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They're quite formal for fan<n>letters, but
they're always so<n>touching.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not to mention carefully crafted. I can<n>see the
improvement in their<n>handwriting with each one.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
They've even started being creative,<n>incorporating
seasonal themes and<n>sometimes writing haikus.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Each letter they write demonstrates<n>how in tune
they are with my<n>interests.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can tell how much this fan wants to<n>make Grass
Wonder happy.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It's not just this fan, either—I've<n>received a
number of letters<n>illustrating aspects of Japanese
culture or explaining unique regional<n>traditions...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
When I receive letters like these from<n>people
around the country, it makes<n>me feel like... like...
choice_data_list: Like you don't want to let them down?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. It makes losing even<n>less of an
option.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: A fire quietly blazes in Grass<n>Wonder's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Through thick and thin, I'll remain<n>committed. I'll be
relying on your<n>dedication as well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the fan support has<n>boosted Grass
Wonder's spirits.
